caseName: Ex parte W. G. Coyle & Co.
caseNameFull: EX PARTE W. G. COYLE & CO.
syllabus: Motion for leave to file petition for a writ of mandamus to a Circuit Judge to remand a case removed from the state to the Federal court denied.
summary:
MOTION FOR LEAVE TO FILE PETITION FOR A WRIT OF MANDAMUS.

This was a motion for leave to file a petition for a writ of mandamus to require the Circuit Judge to remand a case which had been removed from the state court and which involved the validity of a sale of a vessel by a United States marshal under execution.
attorneys: Mr. Charles Louque for the petitioners., Mr. Edwin T. Merrick and Mr. John D. Grace for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Motion for leave to file petition for a writ of mandamus denied.
